name: Sustainable Urban Mobility Systems
description: Urban mobility challenge; urban passenger transport – non-motorized transport (NMT), formal and informal public transport, private motorized transport; high-capacity public transport – metro, light rail and bus rapid transit (BRT); urban goods transport; mobility and its impacts on urban form, equity, accessibility, health and the environment; transit-oriented development (TOD); economic and financial challenges of urban mobility; institutional and governance frameworks for urban mobility; policies and practices for sustainable urban mobility.
